text: 盘前必读丨央行将开展8000亿元MLF操作；中际旭创回购近8亿 机构认为，沪指整数关口存在压力，需要反复消化。
text_en: Pre-market must-read丨PBOC to conduct 800 billion yuan MLF operation; Zhongji Innolight repurchases nearly 800 million yuan. Institutions believe the Shanghai Composite faces pressure at the integer level and needs repeated digestion.
